title: नेपाली ‘नेल्सन मण्डेला’ देखि माया ज्ञवालीसम्म- एमाले भेलामा देखिएको लिजेण्डको पुनर्मिलन
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । बबरमहलमा जारी नेकपा एमालेको राष्ट्रिय भेलामा ‘नेपाली नेल्सन मण्डेला’ भनी चिनिएका मोहनचन्द्र अधिकारी, संस्थापक पुष्पलालका भाइ विजयलाल, दिवंगत नेता जिवराज आश्रितपत्नी माया ज्ञवालीसम्म देखिएका छन् । अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओलीले पार्टीमा काम गरिरहेकै नेताहरूको बेवास्ता गर्न छाडेको आरोप खेपिरहँदा पछिल्लो समय पार्टी गतिविधिमा नदेखिएका र पार्टी कामको मतलब गर्न छोडेका नेता मोहनचन्द्र अधिकारी देखिएका छन् । उनी २०७९ को एमाले विभाजनका क्रममा माधवकुमार नेपाल नेतृत्वको एकीकृत समाजवादी निकट र उक्त पार्टीले गठन गरेको ज्येष्ठ कम्युनिष्ट मञ्चमा समेत रहेका थिए । उक्त पार्टी तत्कालीन माओवादी केन्द्रसहितको एकतामा सामेल भई नेपाली कम्युनिष्ट पार्टीका रुपमा क्रियाशील भएदेखि अधिकारी त्यहाँ देखिन छोडेका थिए । तर, एमाले फर्किएको घोषणा गरेका थिएनन् । भेलामा ११ वर्षपछि वरिष्ठ नेताका रूपमा विद्या भण्डारी सहभागी भएकी छन् । त्यस्तै, साढे ३ वर्षपछि टोपबहादुर रायमाझी समेत उपस्थित छन् । रायमाझी नेकपा विभाजनपछि माओवादी धारा छाडेर एमालेमा बसेका र सचिव भइसकेका नेता हुन् । एमाले स्थायी कमिटी सदस्य तथा विदेश विभाग प्रमुख प्रदीप ज्ञवालीलाई अधिकारीको उपस्थितिबारे जिज्ञासा राख्दा उनी र उनीजस्ता एमाले निर्माणकालदेखिका योद्धालाई आफ्नो पार्टी आउनका लागि कुनै निम्तो, साइत र घोषणा आवश्यक नपर्ने बताए । ‘अरु थुप्रै कमरेड आउन बाँकी हुनुहुन्छ, आन्दोलनका क्रममा भएका मीठा-नमीठा कुरा एकातिर हुन्छन्, यो आन्दोलनको रक्षा गर्नुपर्ने बेलामा उहाँहरू सतिसाल झैँ उभिनुहुन्छ भन्ने हाम्रो विश्वास छ’, उनले भने । राष्ट्रिय भेलामा प्रतीकात्मक सहभागितास्वरूप संस्थापक महासचिव पुष्पलालका भाइ विजयलाल पनि छन् । उनी पनि एमालेका गतिविधिमा प्रायः देखिँदैन थिए । तर, विजयलाललाई ‘सांकेतिक’ का रूपमा नभएर आन्दोलनकै अङ्गको रूपमा समेटिएको ज्ञवाली बताउँछन् । ‘अरुलाई देखाउन हैन, नेकपा एमालेलाई अझ सशक्त बनाउने सङ्कल्प बोकेर उहाँहरू आउनुभएको छ’, उनले भने । दासढुङ्गा दुर्घटनामा दिवंगत तत्कालीन महासचिव मदन भण्डारीकी पत्नीसमेत रहेकी पूर्वराष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारी र आश्रितपत्नी ज्ञवालीको उपस्थिति देखेपछि भेलाका सहभागीहरू ‘ओली क्रमशः सच्चिएको’ टिप्पणी गरिरहेका थिए । प्रचार विभाग प्रमुख निरज आचार्यले भण्डारी र ज्ञवाली निरन्तर पार्टी र आन्दोलनमा रहेको बिर्सन नहुने बताए । भण्डारी राष्ट्रपतिको भूमिकामा रहँदा नियमित गतिविधिमा नदेखिएको भन्दै उनले भने, ‘पदबाट फिर्ता हुनुभएपछि उहाँ पार्टी र आन्दोलनको चिन्तामा नै हुनुहुन्थ्यो ।’ ज्ञवाली पनि पार्टीका गतिविधिमा नियमित रुपमै सरिक हुँदै आएको उनले बताए । Kathmandu. Mohan Chandra Adhikari, known as the 'Nepali Nelson Mandela', founder Pushpalal's brother Vijayalal, and late leader Jibaraj's dependent wife Maya Gyawali were seen at the ongoing CPN-UML national gathering in Babarmahal. While Chairman KP Sharma Oli is facing accusations of neglecting the leaders who are still working in the party, leader Mohan Chandra Adhikari has been absent from party activities recently and has stopped caring about party work. He was close to the Unified Socialist Party led by Madhav Kumar Nepal during the UML split in 2079 and was also in the Senior Communist Forum formed by that party. Adhikari had stopped appearing there since the party joined the then Maoist Center and became active as the Nepali Communist Party. However, he had not announced his return to the UML. Vidya Bhandari has participated in the gathering as a senior leader after 11 years. Similarly, Top Bahadur Rayamajhi is also present after 3 and a half years. Rayamajhi is a leader who left the Maoist wing after the split of the CPN (Maoist) and joined the UML and became its secretary. When asked about Adhikari's presence, UML Standing Committee member and Foreign Department Chief Pradeep Gyawali said that he and UML warriors like him since its formation did not need any invitation, site, or announcement to come to his party. "Many more comrades are yet to come. The pleasantries and unpleasantries that occurred during the movement are set aside. We believe that they will stand firm like Satisal when it comes to defending this movement," he said. Vijayalal, the brother of founding general secretary Pushpalal, is also present at the national gathering as a symbolic participant. He was also not often seen in UML activities. However, Gyawali says that Vijayalal is included not as a 'symbolic' person but as part of the movement. "They have come with the determination to make the CPN-UML even stronger, not to show off to others," he said. The participants of the gathering were commenting that 'Oli has gradually become a better person' after seeing the presence of former President Bidya Devi Bhandari, who was also the wife of the then General Secretary Madan Bhandari, who died in the Dasdhunga accident, and his dependent wife Gyawali. Head of the Publicity Department, Niraj Acharya, said that it should not be forgotten that Bhandari and Gyawali were constantly involved in the party and the movement. Stating that Bhandari was not seen in regular activities while in the role of President, he said, "After returning from office, he was concerned about the party and the movement." He said that Gyawali has also been regularly participating in party activities.

नभएर आन्दोलनकै अङ्गको रूपमा समेटिएको ज्ञवाली बताउँछन् । ‘अरुलाई देखाउन हैन, नेकपा एमालेलाई अझ सशक्त बनाउने सङ्कल्प बोकेर उहाँहरू आउनुभएको छ’, उनले भने । दासढुङ्गा दुर्घटनामा दिवंगत तत्कालीन महासचिव मदन भण्डारीकी पत्नीसमेत रहेकी पूर्वराष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारी र आश्रितपत्नी ज्ञवालीको उपस्थिति देखेपछि भेलाका सहभागीहरू ‘ओली क्रमशः सच्चिएको’ टिप्पणी गरिरहेका थिए । प्रचार विभाग प्रमुख निरज आचार्यले भण्डारी र ज्ञवाली निरन्तर पार्टी र आन्दोलनमा रहेको बिर्सन नहुने बताए । भण्डारी राष्ट्रपतिको भूमिकामा रहँदा नियमित गतिविधिमा नदेखिएको भन्दै उनले भने, ‘पदबाट फिर्ता हुनुभएपछि उहाँ पार्टी र आन्दोलनको चिन्तामा नै हुनुहुन्थ्यो ।’ ज्ञवाली पनि पार्टीका गतिविधिमा नियमित रुपमै सरिक हुँदै आएको उनले बताए । Kathmandu. Mohan Chandra Adhikari, known as the 'Nepali Nelson Mandela', founder Pushpalal's brother Vijayalal, and late leader Jibaraj's dependent wife Maya Gyawali were seen at the ongoing CPN-UML national gathering in Babarmahal. While Chairman KP Sharma Oli is facing accusations of neglecting the leaders who are still working in the party, leader Mohan Chandra Adhikari has been absent from party activities recently and has stopped caring about party work. He was close to the Unified Socialist Party led by Madhav Kumar Nepal during the UML split in 2079 and was also in the Senior Communist Forum formed by that party. Adhikari had stopped appearing there since the party joined the then Maoist Center and became active as the Nepali Communist Party. However, he had not announced his return to the UML. Vidya Bhandari has participated in the gathering as a senior leader after 11 years. Similarly, Top Bahadur Rayamajhi is also present after 3 and a half years. Rayamajhi is a leader who left the Maoist wing after the split of the CPN (Maoist) and joined the UML and became its secretary. When asked about Adhikari's presence, UML Standing Committee member and Foreign Department Chief Pradeep Gyawali said that he and UML warriors like him since its formation did not need any invitation, site, or announcement to come to his party. "Many more comrades are yet to come. The pleasantries and unpleasantries that occurred during the movement are set aside. We believe that they will stand firm like Satisal when it comes to defending this movement," he said. Vijayalal, the brother of founding general secretary Pushpalal, is also present at the national gathering as a symbolic participant. He was also not often seen in UML activities. However, Gyawali says that Vijayalal is included not as a 'symbolic' person but as part of the movement. "They have come with the determination to make the CPN-UML even stronger, not to show off to others," he said. The participants of the gathering were commenting that 'Oli has gradually become a better person' after seeing the presence of former President Bidya Devi Bhandari, who was also the wife of the then General Secretary Madan Bhandari, who died in the Dasdhunga accident, and his dependent wife Gyawali. Head of the Publicity Department, Niraj Acharya, said that it should not be forgotten that Bhandari and Gyawali were constantly involved in the party and the movement. Stating that Bhandari was not seen in regular activities while in the role of President, he said, "After returning from office, he was concerned about the party and the movement." He said that Gyawali has also been regularly participating in party activities.

छोडेका नेता मोहनचन्द्र अधिकारी देखिएका छन् । उनी २०७९ को एमाले विभाजनका क्रममा माधवकुमार नेपाल नेतृत्वको एकीकृत समाजवादी निकट र उक्त पार्टीले गठन गरेको ज्येष्ठ कम्युनिष्ट मञ्चमा समेत रहेका थिए । उक्त काठमाडौं । बबरमहलमा जारी नेकपा एमालेको राष्ट्रिय भेलामा ‘नेपाली नेल्सन मण्डेला’ भनी चिनिएका मोहनचन्द्र अधिकारी, संस्थापक पुष्पलालका भाइ विजयलाल, दिवंगत नेता जिवराज आश्रितपत्नी माया ज्ञवालीसम्म देखिएका छन् । अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओलीले पार्टीमा काम गरिरहेकै नेताहरूको बेवास्ता गर्न छाडेको आरोप खेपिरहँदा पछिल्लो समय पार्टी गतिविधिमा नदेखिएका र पार्टी कामको मतलब गर्न छोडेका नेता मोहनचन्द्र अधिकारी देखिएका छन् । उनी २०७९ को एमाले विभाजनका क्रममा माधवकुमार नेपाल नेतृत्वको एकीकृत समाजवादी निकट र उक्त पार्टीले गठन गरेको ज्येष्ठ कम्युनिष्ट मञ्चमा समेत रहेका थिए । उक्त पार्टी तत्कालीन माओवादी केन्द्रसहितको एकतामा सामेल भई नेपाली कम्युनिष्ट पार्टीका रुपमा क्रियाशील भएदेखि अधिकारी त्यहाँ देखिन छोडेका थिए । तर, एमाले फर्किएको घोषणा गरेका थिएनन् । भेलामा ११ वर्षपछि वरिष्ठ नेताका रूपमा विद्या भण्डारी सहभागी भएकी छन् । त्यस्तै, साढे ३ वर्षपछि टोपबहादुर रायमाझी समेत उपस्थित छन् । रायमाझी नेकपा विभाजनपछि माओवादी धारा छाडेर एमालेमा बसेका र सचिव भइसकेका नेता हुन् । एमाले स्थायी कमिटी सदस्य तथा विदेश विभाग प्रमुख प्रदीप ज्ञवालीलाई अधिकारीको उपस्थितिबारे जिज्ञासा राख्दा उनी र उनीजस्ता एमाले निर्माणकालदेखिका योद्धालाई आफ्नो पार्टी आउनका लागि कुनै निम्तो, साइत र घोषणा आवश्यक नपर्ने बताए । ‘अरु थुप्रै कमरेड आउन बाँकी हुनुहुन्छ, आन्दोलनका क्रममा भएका मीठा-नमीठा कुरा एकातिर हुन्छन्, यो आन्दोलनको रक्षा गर्नुपर्ने बेलामा उहाँहरू सतिसाल झैँ उभिनुहुन्छ भन्ने हाम्रो विश्वास छ’, उनले भने । राष्ट्रिय भेलामा प्रतीकात्मक सहभागितास्वरूप संस्थापक महासचिव पुष्पलालका भाइ विजयलाल पनि छन् । उनी पनि एमालेका गतिविधिमा प्रायः देखिँदैन थिए । तर, विजयलाललाई ‘सांकेतिक’ का रूपमा नभएर आन्दोलनकै अङ्गको रूपमा समेटिएको ज्ञवाली बताउँछन् । ‘अरुलाई देखाउन हैन, नेकपा एमालेलाई अझ सशक्त बनाउने सङ्कल्प बोकेर उहाँहरू आउनुभएको छ’, उनले भने । दासढुङ्गा दुर्घटनामा दिवंगत तत्कालीन महासचिव मदन भण्डारीकी पत्नीसमेत रहेकी पूर्वराष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारी र आश्रितपत्नी ज्ञवालीको उपस्थिति देखेपछि भेलाका सहभागीहरू ‘ओली क्रमशः सच्चिएको’ टिप्पणी गरिरहेका थिए । प्रचार विभाग प्रमुख निरज आचार्यले भण्डारी र ज्ञवाली निरन्तर पार्टी र आन्दोलनमा रहेको बिर्सन नहुने बताए । भण्डारी राष्ट्रपतिको भूमिकामा रहँदा नियमित गतिविधिमा नदेखिएको भन्दै उनले भने, ‘पदबाट फिर्ता हुनुभएपछि उहाँ पार्टी र आन्दोलनको चिन्तामा नै हुनुहुन्थ्यो ।’ ज्ञवाली पनि पार्टीका गतिविधिमा नियमित रुपमै सरिक हुँदै आएको उनले बताए ।

Kathmandu. Mohan Chandra Adhikari, known as the 'Nepali Nelson Mandela', founder Pushpalal's brother Vijayalal, and late leader Jibaraj's dependent wife Maya Gyawali were seen at the ongoing CPN-UML national gathering in Babarmahal. While Chairman KP Sharma Oli is facing accusations of neglecting the leaders who are still working in the party, leader Mohan Chandra Adhikari has been absent from party activities recently and has stopped caring about party work. He was close to the Unified Socialist Party led by Madhav Kumar Nepal during the UML split in 2079 and was also in the Senior Communist Forum formed by that party. Adhikari had stopped appearing there since the party joined the then Maoist Center and became active as the Nepali Communist Party. However, he had not announced his return to the UML. Vidya Bhandari has participated in the gathering as a senior leader after 11 years. Similarly, Top Bahadur Rayamajhi is also present after 3 and a half years. Rayamajhi is a leader who left the Maoist wing after the split of the CPN (Maoist) and joined the UML and became its secretary. When asked about Adhikari's presence, UML Standing Committee member and Foreign Department Chief Pradeep Gyawali said that he and UML warriors like him since its formation did not need any invitation, site, or announcement to come to his party. "Many more comrades are yet to come. The pleasantries and unpleasantries that occurred during the movement are set aside. We believe that they will stand firm like Satisal when it comes to defending this movement," he said. Vijayalal, the brother of founding general secretary Pushpalal, is also present at the national gathering as a symbolic participant. He was also not often seen in UML activities. However, Gyawali says that Vijayalal is included not as a 'symbolic' person but as part of the movement. "They have come with the determination to make the CPN-UML even stronger, not to show off to others," he said. The participants of the gathering were commenting that 'Oli has gradually become a better person' after seeing the presence of former President Bidya Devi Bhandari, who was also the wife of the then General Secretary Madan Bhandari, who died in the Dasdhunga accident, and his dependent wife Gyawali. Head of the Publicity Department, Niraj Acharya, said that it should not be forgotten that Bhandari and Gyawali were constantly involved in the party and the movement. Stating that Bhandari was not seen in regular activities while in the role of President, he said, "After returning from office, he was concerned about the party and the movement." He said that Gyawali has also been regularly participating in party activities.
